sentences.en: Pop artists thrive on the adulation of their loyal fans.
sentences.zh: 波普艺术家依靠忠实粉丝的追捧而兴旺。

sentences.en: He that will thrive must ask leave of his wife.
sentences.zh: 要想发达，就得向老婆请示。

sentences.en: The cinema industry of Timor-Leste is thriving like never before.
sentences.zh: 东帝汶的电影业比以往任何时候都要繁荣昌盛。

senses.zh: 茁壮成长，兴旺，繁荣；（尤指在别人觉得困难的时候）以……为乐，可以出色应对
